The '''E-115 Fusion Saboteur''' was a type of [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] available during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].
